minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, February 18, 2026

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, February 18, 2026.

  Members present: Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, George Borst, Jenny Jolly.

  Members Absent: Edward Padgett, Scott Snider, Valerie Ortiz.

  Staff Present: Armando Cisneros, Parks & Recreation Specialist, Robyn
  Olsen, Parks & Recreation Specialist.

  It was moved by Bette Donovan and seconded by Terry Kistler to approve the
  minutes of Wednesday, January 21,2026 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 549 meals were served to an average of 29 participants in
  January.

  Meals on Wheels: 627 meals were served in the month of October 2025 to La
  Verne Recipients. 497 meals were served in the month of November 2025 to
  La Verne Recipients. 534 meals were served in the month of December 2025
  to La Verne Recipients.

4. Bingo Report: Bingo is doing well. The January receipts totaled $7,650.00
  after payouts totaled $6,600.00. Bingo west supplies $830.00. La Verne rent
  was $220.00. Attendance was 251.

5. Account Balance: NA.

6. Senior Program Fees: All program fees are paid.

7. MT. SAC Classes: The winter session ended on Friday, February 13th. The spring
  session will begin on Monday, February 23rd.
 8. Aging Next: Total Number of La Verne Residents served for the month of
  January: NA.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Armando reported the leak in the senior craft room will be
  repaired. There are some small leaks in the Community Center after the
  heavy rains. Veterans Hall is in good condition.

10. Upcoming Events

  •  Thursday, February 19th – Excursion: Soboba Casino, 9:00AM-5:00PM.
  •  Wednesday, March 4th – Senior Seminar: How much is Too Much, YWCA 10:30AM.
  •  Friday, March 6th – Excursion: Getty Villa and Malibu Country Mart, 8:00AM-5:00PM.
  •  Monday, March 9th –Movie Matinee: The Descendents, 12:30PM.

  Public Comments: None.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:45AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, March 18, 2026 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Parks & Recreation Specialist
